title: Kusanagi Nene — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few weeks before Nene's birthday
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? My birthday party?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's fast approaching, is it not?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were thinking it would be nice to celebrate with Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So we wanna have a party here in SEKAI that night!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see. Hehe, thanks guys.
I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're planning something that's gonna put a big smile on your face☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! We're working on this new show...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! Hold it right there! That's top secret!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oops! You're right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehehe, sorry about that!
I just really wanna talk about it already!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm interested to see what you have planned.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, Nene, do you have any daytime plans for your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, not really.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For a day that comes only once a year, we can't allow that to happen. Why don't you make some plans?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Plan something? Like what?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like... I know! Why not hold your own birthday party?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure if I'm the sort of person who does something like that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh? You know, while it feels nice to have friends plan something for you, it's also okay to get proactive!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It might not be a bad idea, actually.
You have many more friends than you used to, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I think it'd be super duper fun too☆
C'mon Nene, you should try doing it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm really not that kind of person...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I guess it would be nice to show my appreciation to everyone who's become my friend.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh alright, I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It is your birthday after all!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That being said, the preparations will be a lot for one person to handle. I'll lend a hand if you like.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too, me too! I'm gonna help you put on a super exciting wonderhoy birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, thanks. I'm gonna try my best...!
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? You're having a birthday party?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. Um... I was wondering if you'd like to come...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, but I won't be offended if you're busy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha, I wouldn't miss it!
Actually, I was already hoping to do something for your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean... You already had something planned?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... I was thinking about it, but I hadn't made up my mind about what to do or anything, so it's all good!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks for the invite!
Oh yeah! Akito and Toya are invited too, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then I'll let them know for you, since I'm meeting them later anyway.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In that case, if you wouldn't mind... Thank you, Shiraishi.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your birthday party?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, are you sure you're okay with me going?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. I'd be very happy if you joined...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd love to! Thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really? I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, who else is going?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The rest of my troupe and Shiraishi. Then there's Hanasato, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'm going to message the rest of Leo/need now to invite them as well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so nervous... I've never really sent a message like this before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I sort of get what you mean...
But don't worry. They'll be so pleased you invited them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I hope so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, does it look okay how I've written it? I didn't make any mistakes, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, this reads fine to me. It's a lovely message, and it's really clear.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you. That's a relief...
Th-Then... I'll hit send.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can do it...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh my gosh...! I-I'm already getting replies!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What are they saying?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They can all make it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's great news...!
This is going to be one lively birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, come to think of it... Are you hosting the party at your house? Even with just the people who've replied, it's going to be quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I wonder if we can all fit in...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Oh! I think I know where you can host it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You do...?
